_note: Every weapon's Military levels, Special names, levels and challenges, and the Completionist challenges, are from the in-game Multiplayer camo screens (screen recording, 16 Oct 2026). The game shows no level for the Mosin-Nagant's Brown and Gunmetal, so they have none here; FINN LMG's Thunderhead reads 'Get 0 Player Kills without Dying 30 times' in game and is copied as shown. The Warlord's Platinum is its own (byWeapon "24": 50 hipfire kills, not the Shotguns' 125). Mastery: tier 1 opens after Divergence ('Complete &&1 Harmonic Break Challenges'), tier 2 (Polyatomic Reforged) 10 kills in a match 250 times and tier 3 (Orion Reforged) 5 kills without dying 250 times (user, correcting @cs_buh's '3 kills without taking damage'), tier 2 from @cs_buh on 17 Oct 2026 (that post names them a tier early; the recording shows Mercurial Drift needs Divergence). Tier 1's Harmonic Break count is still the game's placeholder &&1, so it's a tick box. Mastery is mode-wide (unlock "mode"): Harmonic Break on every weapon is the weapon side; after that the three Mastery challenges count with any weapon. Divergence's final.harmonicBreaksNeeded (33, every weapon) is confirmed by @cs_buh. UPDATE 19 Oct 2026: Mastery from the official launch blog (callofduty.com, 'Ready for Launch: Progression and Prestige'): tier 1 Mercurial Drift opens with Divergence and is 10 kills in a match 250 times, tier 2 Polyatomic Reforged 3 kills without taking damage 300 times, tier 3 Orion Reforged 5 kills without dying 500 times. The same blog says a camo completed in any mode unlocks in all modes; each mode keeps its own counts (an app change, not data).
